extension.summary: C.O.S.M.O.S - Cinema On-demand Streaming Multimedia Operating System
extension.description: C.O.S.M.O.S is a playlist-driven Kodi video addon that reads its menu and content from a remote base URL. It resolves file-host links via ResolveURL or Debrid and auto-plays torrent sources via Torrentio and The Pirate Bay for Search4k / Search1080 / Search720 tokens. Supports Real-Debrid, AllDebrid, Premiumize, TorBox, LinkSnappy and Offcloud using the same proven flow as Trakt Player (zeus768). Freebie TV includes Tubi TV, Pluto TV, and Plex regional catalogues and playback, plus Samsung TV Plus, BBC channels, and Rakuten TV regional live channels with current/next programme metadata, plus Trakt and Simkl tracking integrations. TMDB is used for metadata, with optional free anonymous AI Horde semantic expansion in Universal Search. Release Hub includes TorrentClaw browsing with TMDB season/episode menus and a dedicated source picker. TorrentClaw magnet playback requires a free TorrentClaw API key and a configured Debrid account.
extension.disclaimer: This addon does not host any content.
